name: Fraud Type 2 Code
definition: Identifies the type of fraud in a card payment environment.

ACTO.name: Account Takeover
ACTO.definition: Fraudulent transaction due to the unauthorised use of a card account by a person with the intent to defraud the issuer of the card.

CWUI.name: Counterfeit With Unassigned IIN
CWUI.definition: Fraudulent transaction where the acquirer confirmed that the IIN (Issuer Identification Number) used was either never issued or is invalid.

CRNT.name: Card Not Received
CRNT.definition: Fraudulent transaction with a card that was not received by the cardholder.

FRAP.name: Fraudulent Application
FRAP.definition: Fraudulent transaction on an account that the cardholder never applied for or the information on the application was falsified.

CWKA.name: Counterfeit With Existing Account
CWKA.definition: Fraudulent transaction with an altered or duplicated card in a card-present environment where the cardholder did not knowingly participate or the account was not created.

CRDL.name: Lost Card
CRDL.definition: Fraudulent transaction with a card that has been reported as lost

MISC.name: Miscellaneous
MISC.definition: Fraudulent transaction that cannot be categorised as one of the standard fraud types.

CRDS.name: Stolen Card
CRDS.definition: Fraudulent transaction with a card that has been reported as stolen.

CNPA.name: Card Not Present Account Use
CNPA.definition: Fraudulent use in a card-not-present environment of an account.

MUFD.name: Multiple Use Fraud
MUFD.definition: Merchant makes additional transactions against a card when consumer authorised for one legitimate transaction.

COSN.name: Collusion
COSN.definition: Two parties colluding for the purpose of creating fraudulent transaction. For example, a cardholder and merchant.
